desc:
🏗️ Build your beach base and grow your tycoon empire!

🛢️ Drill for oil and earn cash to expand your base.

🔬 Spend Research Points to unlock powerful upgrades.

🪖 Unlock soldiers, cannons, and tanks to strengthen your defenses.

🌊 Hold the shoreline against wave after wave of enemies.

🤖 Take on giant mech bosses and defend your empire!
